description: Submit an access request for review, as an employee. Validates the fields, writes the request row (a new one, or the returned one at revision + 1 when request_id is given), appends the submitted or resubmitted event, then reviews the request in the same run: the deterministic checks in code, the policy judgment in the access-reviewer subagent. Returns { request_id, revision, recommendation, review_id }. Fired only from the requester's New request form via the direct-invoke lane; not listed in any agent's tools.

request_id.description: Present on a resubmission: the returned request to replace.

role_id.description: A role from the catalog, e.g. netsuite.gl_read.

end_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Not capped: the policy's duration limit is checked by the review.

justification.description: Why the role is needed, in the requester's words.

ticket.description: An onboarding, incident, or change ticket, when there is one.
